name: Home Depot
fiscalYearEnd: Sunday nearest January 31 (FY2025 ended 2026-02-01; FY2026 ends 2027-01-31)
description: Home Depot sells tools, building materials, appliances and home-improvement products to do-it-yourself customers and, increasingly, professional contractors through 2,364 big-box stores in the US, Canada and Mexico. Since 2024 it has bought specialty distributors: SRS Distribution (roofing, landscaping, pool supplies; over 1,340 locations) and GMS (drywall, ceilings, steel framing; bought September 2025, expected about $2B of FY2025 sales). FY2025 (ended Feb 1, 2026) sales were $164.7B (+3.2%) but comparable sales were only +0.3% and operating income fell 3.0% to $20.9B, because housing turnover and big-ticket remodeling are weak. FY2026 guidance: sales +2.5% to +4.5%, operating margin about 12.4% to 12.6%.

businessLines.name: Home Depot retail stores (DIY and Pro)
businessLines.how: Sells products at retail markup to homeowners and contractors; ticket size depends on housing turnover, remodeling and storm activity; includes Pro services and tool rental.

businessLines.name: SRS Distribution and GMS (specialty distribution)
businessLines.how: Wholesale distribution of roofing, landscaping, pool and wallboard products to contractors with delivery from branches; margin is set by contractor volumes.

brands.name: SRS Distribution
brands.note: Acquired FY2024; roofing, landscaping and pool distribution

brands.name: GMS
brands.note: Acquired by SRS September 2025; drywall, ceilings, steel framing

brands.name: HD Supply
brands.note: Earlier Pro distribution business; excluded from customer-transaction metrics

whatsNext.text: About 15 new stores in FY2026 and continued SRS/GMS branch expansion
